description:
John William Kiggundu (JWK) International Hospital Kakiri is a modern, private healthcare institution established to provide affordable, highly accessible, and premier quality healthcare services to the people of Uganda and the broader East African region.

Founded by Dr. Henry K. Lukwago, the hospital opened in October 2023 as an initial 50-bed modern facility. Our Advanced Imaging & Pathology Lab provides elite diagnostic accuracy with state-of-the-art equipment.

**Position: Radiographer (1 Position)**

**Responsibilities:**
- Perform diagnostic imaging procedures (X-ray, CT, MRI)
- Ensure proper operation and maintenance of imaging equipment
- Produce high-quality diagnostic images for clinical review
- Follow radiation safety protocols and standards
- Prepare patients for imaging procedures and explain processes
- Maintain accurate imaging records and documentation
- Collaborate with radiologists and clinical teams for diagnosis

**Requirements:**
- Bachelor's degree in Radiography or equivalent from a recognized institution
- Valid registration and license from Uganda Allied Health Professionals Council
- Experience operating X-ray, CT, and MRI equipment
- Strong knowledge of radiation safety and protection
- Excellent technical and analytical skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a diagnostic team

**How to Apply:**

**Physical Delivery:** Hospital Admin Office, Kakiri - Opposite Police Barracks
**Email:** jwkhospital@gmail.com
**Contact:** +256 200 992 222

**Deadline:** 5th September 2026

John William Kiggundu International Hospital Kakiri - Delivering quality healthcare with compassion.
